parsed.degree_signal: Master’s or PhD in robotics, computer science, engineering, or a related field
parsed.notes:
Essential Skills is required; Beneficial Skills is optional. Technologies and practices appearing only in responsibilities or company descriptions are excluded.
Python and C++ form the first retained alternative group. RL is independently required by familiarity with RL algorithms, so it does not remain grouped with IL.
Unmapped alternatives include Stable Baselines 3/RSL-RL and IsaacSim/MuJoCo; no taxonomy IDs were invented for them.
Policy training is provisionally mapped to model-development as training learned models; the specialized locomotion/locomanipulation technique is also recorded as unmapped.
Control theory and robot kinematics/dynamics are retained as unmapped technical competencies; this boundary with excluded domain knowledge warrants review.
Humanoid/high-DOF robot experience is treated as application-domain experience, not a separate skill. Publication history and soft skills are excluded.
